item.title: I made adjustments for my article, any feedbacks?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP article

Elevator Pitch: * I want more attention for the Manna Charitable Foundation. Make them look good but not threating.

Central Narrative: It will start off with how a hostile SCP was found inside a container. The container is from the MCF but I won't mention it for a bit of mystery. I read that the MCF has “abnormal assets” so I will use that for a storyline. I do not like to make the article long so I will no longer explain or add more test to some areas. When the reader reaches the end, there they will find out it was the MCF.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The attention grabber here would be the MCF and its “abnormal assets”. Basically the article would talk about how the MCF handled an entity and brought to the SCP.

Additional Notes: I wrote this article because I want more involvement from the MCF. The MCF looks like joke in some perspective but this article would give it maybe more attention and mystery. I already made a draft and if you look to give a feedback or greenlight just reply. I made I few adjustments to my article. Just ask for the sandbox. Feel free to criticize
